kquarto.r.inrae: 'Quarto' Book Templates Following the INRAE Graphic Charter

Source: R/kquarto.r.inrae-package.R
kquarto.r.inrae-package.Rd

Ships an 'INRAE' template for the 'Quarto' books created with 'kquarto.r' (colours, fonts, logo, title page and bibliography) and makes it the default template of the book creation helpers.
